# Demo script (Fire TV track, 3–4 min)

Everything in this walk-through comes out of `make demo` (scripts/box-demo.sh): two
**synthetic** games generated by `courtcam synth` and processed by the worker on hfbox,
served by the real API to the TV app's web build and the phone companion. No real
footage, no mock data. Every game title starts with "SYNTHETIC" and stays on screen.

## Before recording

```sh
make demo          # sync, build (cold ~7.5 min on an idle box, warm ~10 s; docs/perf.md), serve
make demo-tunnel   # in a second terminal; keep it open
```

- **TV**: Chrome at `http://localhost:5190/`, window 1920×1080 (the 10-foot UI is laid
  out and tested at 1080p). Keyboard = remote: arrows = D-pad, Enter = Select, Esc =
  Back. The same screens build into the react-native-tvos APK (D-37), but **the APK has
  never run on a Fire TV or emulator** — record the web build and say so.
- **Phone**: a second, phone-sized window (or a phone on the same machine's tunnel) at
  `http://localhost:5191/companion`.
- Games in the library: `SYNTHETIC basketball (demo)` (60 s, full court, 10 mannequin
  players) and `SYNTHETIC pickleball doubles (demo)` (60 s).
- Stop with `make demo-stop`.

## Beats

| time | beat | what to press | what the viewer sees |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:15 | **Hook** | — (voice-over) | "One phone on a tripod in, a broadcast on your TV out." Library with two game cards. |
| 0:15–0:40 | **Library → Watch (wide)** | Enter on the basketball card | Wide shot playing; event markers and the hype meter on the scrubber. |
| 0:40–1:05 | **Select → Follow → Spotlight → inset** | Enter pauses into select mode; arrows hop the focus ring between players (repeat a direction to cycle overlapping players); Enter on one → follow-cam; Up → Playback ▸ Spotlight | The 4K-style wide becomes a smooth 1080p follow-cam on that player, spotlight ring, court inset minimap with every player's dot. |
| 1:05–1:35 | **Broadcast mode + commentary** | Back to wide; Up → Broadcast, then Commentary; Enter plays | The auto-directed rendition: score bug, LIVE bug, cuts wide/tight/follow, a 0.5× REPLAY with telestrator (ring, trail, shot arc to the 3.05 m rim) and a sting; captions from the grounded template commentary; Kokoro narration ducked under game audio (if TTS was available at build time, else captions only). |
| 1:35–2:00 | **"Replay, clip that" — phone tap** | Phone: enter the 4-digit code the TV shows under Pair phone; while the TV plays, tap **Clip that** | Toast on the TV; Game ▸ Clips shows a new "Phone tap" clip of the play that just ended, owned and cross-linked. Show the D-pad trim handles. |
| 2:00–2:15 | **Gesture / voice (evidence, not live)** | cut to `docs/evidence/M5/trigger_gesture_synthetic_basketball_half_s7.mp4` and `trigger_voice_…mp4` | The synthetic generator's X-over-head gesture and the spoken "Replay, clip that" each cut the right play. Say that live gesture/voice need staged real footage (not done). |
| 2:15–2:50 | **Replay angles A/B/C** | Game ▸ Replays → Enter on a highlight; Left/Right | Same moment from wide, follow, tight (Tier A), broadcast-high / orbit / push-in 2.5D cutouts (Tier B, labelled "flat player cutouts"), and stylized 3D mannequins from baseline / overhead / reverse / shooter's POV (Tier C, labelled "3D reconstruction - stylized"). The playhead stays on the same instant across cuts. |
| 2:50–3:10 | **Highlights + search** | Game ▸ Highlights; Game ▸ Search, type "a steal" with the on-screen keyboard (or send it from the phone search box → Play on TV) | Ranked plays; with the SigLIP index built, results come from `/search`, else the labelled keyword fallback. |
| 3:10–3:30 | **Review + box score** | Game ▸ Review | Shot chart, "auto-detected" box score with confidence, the review queue answered with the remote (Made / Missed / Not a shot). |
| 3:30–3:45 | **Player card** | Players ▸ Profiles → a profile → card tab | Collectible card PNG with a grounded title. Only if the profiles screens are in the build and a profile has been created/linked for the demo game (see caveats). |
| 3:45–4:00 | **9:16 share + net sport** | Game ▸ Clips → Share 9:16 on a clip; then Library → pickleball → Game ▸ Rallies → condensed game | Portrait export with burned-in caption (the top highlight's export is pre-rendered by `make demo`); pickleball rally browser and the condensed game with the RALLY n / N counter. Close on the architecture slide (README diagram). |

Total ≈ 4:00; drop the gesture/voice cut-away and the player card to land at 3:15.

## Honest caveats to say or caption

- **Synthetic data.** Players are generated mannequins on a rendered court; detection,
  poses and events here run with the synthetic detector and ground-truth poses, so the
  demo shows the product loop, not real-footage accuracy. Real-footage numbers (tracking
  IDF1, shot recall, gesture recall 0.41) are in docs/progress.md.
- **Device not tested.** The Fire TV APK builds (arm64/armv7) but has never run on a Fire
  TV or emulator; the recording is the react-native-web build of the same screens.
- **Generative parts are deterministic.** Commentary text is the grounded template (no
  LLM in the demo build). Narration is Kokoro TTS when its venv exists on the box, else
  captions only. Search uses SigLIP when its venv exists, else the labelled keyword
  match. SAM 2.1 masks need the box GPU (`DEMO_FAKE_SEGMENT=1` falls back to ellipses).
- **Tier B/C are approximations** and are labelled as such on every frame: flat
  billboards, plate ghosts, no jumps, ball arcs drawn from the calibrated rim height;
  basketball shot outcome is "unknown" (ball stops at the rim) until a user answers the
  review question.
- **Player card** needs a profile: the demo build does not create one. Create it in the
  phone companion (or `POST /profiles`, then link a demo player) before recording that
  beat, or skip it.
- AWS: nothing in the demo calls AWS; the provider stubs and CDK skeleton are described
  in docs/aws-integrations.md.
